scientific_integrity: The formula for the labelled smooth realization space is prior work. The new contribution is full matroid automorphism classification and its unlabelled quotient consequences. Finite exhaustive tests supplement, not replace, the general proof.
scientific_limitations: All-odd-level automorphism formula proved only for n>=11; even n and lower odd n not claimed.
Unlabelled moduli conclusion restricted to smooth complex plane-cubic realizations; nodal/cuspidal degenerations not classified.
Generic projective stabilizer statement excludes j=0 and j=1728; integral-stack structures are not computed.
Independently obtained prior literature could contain equivalent statements under other terminology; no independent audit performed.
title: Full symmetries of odd elliptic matroids and the unlabelled modular curve
